request_order: exact inputs/plan.json; never retry or reorder
transport: real resolver/APIClient with CSRF and real middleware/JWT/APIkey; no TCP/Main/Native
startup: real manage.py shell; should_skip_initialization True; no application method patch
seed: exact six actors/two notices/zero dismissals/natural sequences from definition; preserve initial rows before owned isolation
exception_policy: APIClient.raise_request_exception=False; literal framework exception and outer catch distinct; original full byte counts/hashes plus explicit truncation/complete status; truncated exception fails capture
credential_effect_policy: retain raw users/events/cache and actual decoded failed-key history; no reset or normalization
cleanup: exact all-project container --all/network/volume inventory; former CID and PID/start identities; raw commands before assertions; no case-sensitive diagnostic inference
